remarks: Welcome to easy in-town living at Oenoke Condominiums! This sun-filled, immaculate two-bedroom residence on the 2nd floor enjoys a wonderful location overlooking the large, inviting pool, making a refreshing summer dip just steps from your door. Freshly painted and move-in ready, the home features a spacious living room, an easy-flow floor plan, two generously sized bedrooms with large closets, and abundant natural light throughout. Recent updates include a new GE five-burner glass-top range and Whirlpool over-the-range microwave. Replacement windows were installed in 2014 and include a limited lifetime warranty. Additional conveniences include private storage and laundry facilities in the basement, while heat and hot water are included in the common charges. Best of all, leave the car behind! Enjoy an easy stroll to the heart of New Canaan for exceptional dining, unique shops, parks, the library, and Metro-North service to NYC. With New Canaan's highly regarded schools, beautiful parks and outstanding recreational amenities nearby, this bright and beautifully maintained home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience and an exceptional in-town lifestyle.
